assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls (FAR, height, density, setback), road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: Building massing, road skeleton, and density metrics are conceptual only; official planning_limits.json reports these controls as missing.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Official regulatory-planning conditions or design-brief attachments published

assumptions.statement: Official SITE_BOUNDARY and KEY_AREA polygons are not yet published; all scope lines use provisional rough polygons (geometry_role=provisional_constraint, official_boundary=false).
assumptions.impact: All area metrics are provisional re-checks; they cannot be used for official redline, precise-area, or statutory planning-control claims.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Official boundary and key-area GeoJSON published in brief/site-package/geometry/

assumptions.statement: Building footprints, floors_estimate (6-8), total floor area, FAR ~3.23, and building density ~50% are conceptual massing for spatial testing, not approved development indicators.
assumptions.impact: No construction-scale or investment commitment is implied.

assumptions.statement: Road centerlines and widths (greenway 12m, secondary 24m, branch 16m) are conceptual skeleton; existing primary roads are locked layers and were not modified.
assumptions.impact: Road ratio ~5% is an estimate; official redlines and sections pending.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Official road redline and section data published

assumptions.statement: All AI scenario cards, test-validation scenarios, landmarks, event systems, and operation mechanisms are conceptual suggestions for professional deepening.
assumptions.impact: None are presented as approved operations, government arrangements, or engineering conclusions.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: No recalculation; professional deepening required before implementation
